bio: Beppo Tagliapietra's journey from humble stoneworker to respected dockmaster exemplifies the Venetian spirit of industrious transformation. Once hauling stone through narrow calli, he built his reputation on reliability and an uncanny ability to navigate both the physical and social topography of La Serenissima. His years of managing cargo transfers at the Public Dock at Riva delle Assi have honed his instincts for maximizing efficiency while minimizing risk, making him an indispensable figure i
